annotations.title: Record what's true about a transformation level

description: Records what someone told you about one level of a PRIORITY's current transformations, in their words or a faithful summary: that they already do it, what rules it out, a system that isn't ready, work still done on paper, and so on. Compass works out what it means in the background: a label for the level, facts kept on the steps they're about (every later reading of those workflows sees them), and open questions to confirm. Then it reads the priority again. Use it whenever a conversation settles something about a level, so it lands on the priority's page, not only in this chat.
